basic_info.description: A delightful semi-detached single-family home in San Francisco's sought-after Outer Richmond neighborhood. Ideally located just blocks from Golden Gate Park, Lands End, Ocean Beach, local shops, dining, and public transportation. The main level features 2 bedrooms and 1 full bathroom with both a tub and a separate shower stall. Enjoy partial ocean views from both bedrooms, bringing in natural light and a peaceful ambiance. The remodeled kitchen includes granite countertops and maple cabinets connect to the formal dining room and a spacious living roomperfect for everyday living and entertaining. Downstairs, offers a one-car garage, laundry area, a full bath, and a family room. Additional highlights include a circuit breaker panel, copper plumbing, and a visibly bolted foundation. The backyard offers a garden retreat, or creative outdoor living options. This property combines charm, functionality, and location in one of San Francisco's most beloved neighborhoods. A perfect opportunity to enjoy the city's best outdoor spaces, coastal beauty, and neighborhood charm.  Must see !
